phase_8.failure_summary: InvalidOperationException: ParanoiaCascade regressed by more than 25 %: 106,2 MiB/s now, 160,8 MiB/s baseline.
phase_8.method: Release; 16 MiB warmup, five measured 256 MiB passes, 16 MiB native chunks, 10 aggregate CPU permits; chunk copies included; no KDF, nonce-hash, global MAC or archive I/O.
phase_8.scope: All 12 primitive rates measured. Baseline assertion failed before full-container and pipeline phases; no complete PERF_RESULT_JSON emitted for this failed group.
phase_8.precision: Current rates and samples are preserved one-decimal log values. Ratios are approximate; full-precision medians were not recovered.

baseline_used_by_failed_run.scope: September 28 baseline before macOS scheduling changed to bounded GCD Utility jobs; retained as the actual phase-8 comparator.

appropriate_historical_comparison.scope: Faithful extraction of the existing complete passing 536d7c2 group with GCD Utility scheduling. Not a new measurement or invented baseline. Used by the subsequent controlled rerun, which also failed; not the comparator of the original phase-8 run.
appropriate_historical_comparison.conclusion: Appropriate historical comparison does not turn the observed failure into PASS. Cause of the remaining regression is not isolated.

phase_9_entropy.scope: sequential production-component microbenchmark; no archive/release throughput claim
phase_9_entropy.limitations: Sequential production-component microbenchmark with fresh OS randomness; no archive throughput or release completion claim.

phase_10_mac.non_leaf_interval: operation wall minus measured leaf batches; includes ordered root, key setup, memory-stream reads, cleanup, uninstrumented overhead and permit waits; not a universal serial CPU fraction

controlled_cipher_rerun.failure_summary: InvalidOperationException: ParanoiaCascade regressed by more than 25 %: 102,7 MiB/s now, 145,1 MiB/s baseline.
controlled_cipher_rerun.method: Same five measured 256 MiB passes after 16 MiB warmup and unchanged 75-percent baseline gate. Controlled rerun after independent phases 9-12 against complete passing historical 536d7c2 GCD Utility baseline.
controlled_cipher_rerun.scope: Primitive rates recorded; regression assertion failed before full-container/pipeline measurements and complete PERF_RESULT_JSON. This is a second real failed performance gate, not a configuration exit.
controlled_cipher_rerun.precision: Medians and samples available only as one-decimal log values; ratios are approximate.
controlled_cipher_rerun.root_cause: UNKNOWN: no established causal attribution to scheduler, operating-system load, thermals or frequency.

screen_lock_ordering.basis: Release coordinator observation supplied for this documentation update; no separate lock timestamp asserted.
screen_lock_ordering.interpretation: The later screen lock is not an explanation for this measured failure.
